config.reasoning: off / reasoning-budget 0 (matches the normal llm-ornith compose command)
config.launch_method: scratch `docker run --rm`, pinned image digest, port 8096; normal llm-ornith compose service stopped first (docker compose --profile ornith stop llm-ornith); no live .env.models / compose.models.yml edits

observed.measurement_note: sampled 3 times over ~10s (695, 700, 703 MiB free) to check for transient allocation noise; stable within a ~10 MiB band
observed.healthcheck: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8096/v1/models -> 200 OK, n_ctx=8192 confirmed in response meta
observed.confirmed_cli_args: docker inspect Config.Cmd verified: --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --flash-attn on alongside -c 8192, matching the normal ornith launch flags otherwise (--reasoning off --reasoning-budget 0)

comparison_to_baseline.note: NEGATIVE RESULT: quantizing the KV cache to q8_0/q8_0 did NOT free meaningful VRAM for ornith at 8192 context -- free VRAM was actually ~58 MiB LOWER than the f16 baseline (within measurement noise of roughly flat, not a real gain). This is the opposite of the coder result (+354 MiB) and is explained by: (1) the KV cache itself at only 8192 tokens is a very small fraction of this ~21.2 GiB model's VRAM footprint, so halving it saves very little in absolute MiB, and (2) explicitly forcing --flash-attn on (required to get any benefit from quantized KV, per the CPU-fallback caveat in docs/research/TECHNOLOGY_EVALUATION_MATRIX.md) adds its own CUDA compute-buffer overhead that appears to roughly cancel out the small KV saving for this specific model/context combination.

notes: Because this configuration did not free meaningfully more than the ADR-004 507 MiB reference headroom (it did not free anything at all), the benchmark plan's own stated condition for proceeding to a raised context (12288/16384) was not met for ornith. Elevated-context testing was therefore NOT attempted for ornith -- attempting it would mean starting from less headroom than the already-documented-insufficient 507 MiB case, which is expected to OOM and was not worth the additional live-GPU disruption to demonstrate.
This is a valid, expected 'no safe increase' finding for the ornith profile specifically, consistent with the task's own stated expectation given ADR-004's evidence on this hardware.
